lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 13 distinct, high-contrast vertical lines visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the midsection with a slight decrease in inter-line distance approaching the shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation identified at the dorsal terminus of the 4th line from the posterior; a minor spatial split is also visible at the mid-point of the 2nd line from the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most line is abbreviated, terminating mid-torso; multiple isolated white blobs and dashed segments are visible ventrally to lines 2, 3, 4, and 5.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots located on the posterior-lateral haunch, arranged in a roughly rectangular grouping.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Horizontal alignment of three distinct white spots located on the lower flank, inferior to the 5th and 6th vertical lines.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white spot on the muzzle/snout; large white horizontal patch on the lower throat; white bands and spots on the interior and exterior of the forelegs and hindlegs.
